evidence_items.explanation: The developer of the leading LLM of early 2023 says the model, like earlier GPT models, is not fully reliable: it hallucinates facts and makes reasoning errors. This matches the behavioural reading of 'don't reliably understand the world'.

unresolved_gaps: No evidence can settle whether LLMs 'understand' in a deeper sense. The assessment covers behavioural reliability only.
